Question
========
Explain the following concept, spelling out the acronym first if there is one. Give its definition and its usage, and if it has several usages, its most important one.

**Factor**

Solution
========
A parameter that we deliberately vary in an experiment. Parameters that are not factors are kept fixed. Choosing few, meaningful factors is what keeps the experimental design tractable.
